user.title: JOMOO ZS800J BLE
user.description: Close the official mini program. Enter the BLE MAC advertised via a connectable Home Assistant adapter/proxy, not a macOS CoreBluetooth UUID. Setup performs read-only status queries; controls start disabled.

error.invalid_address: Enter six two-digit hexadecimal groups separated by colons.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to obtain fresh E2/EA status. Check model, proxy placement and the single-central constraint.

init.title: Polling and controls
init.description: Enable controls only after checking read-only status on your exact model. Lid/ring commands move hardware and small flush uses water. Unmapped settings still block all writes. Connections can beep; polling shares the single BLE slot with the official app.
